facts.fact: Menos Fios, relaying Expansao no. 878 and Infosi director-general Andre Mpumba, reports that the 12 container modules of the Government's National Data Centre and Cloud at Camama, inaugurated on 28 April 2026, are certified Tier III (factory Tier-ready), though the building is not yet on Uptime Institute's list, and that it hosts data of public and private institutions.
